title: ebay | How To | Sell on eBay using Quick Sale
description: To access Quick Sale, go to http://ebay.to/2dqwthf or click on the link. Quick Sale is a great way to quickly and easily sell your newer generation smart phones on eBay.  eBay YouTube Customer Support Hours are Monday – Friday, 6:00AM – 6:00PM PST. For help outside these hours, please contact eBay Customer Service at http://ebay.to/2elcv5C

asr.full_text: Hello, my name is Andrew and I am part of the eBay Customer Service Team. Today I'm here to tell you about a new and exciting service called QUICKSALE. QuickSale, which is powered by eBay Valle, allows you to sell your previous generation smartphone for quick easy cash, and the best part is it's as easy as 4 steps. So the first option will be select a brand, in this case I have an Apple iPhone 6 Plus, and then from there it's gonna ask you the carrier of your cell phone. So I have Sprint, it'll then ask you for the capacity of the phone, 64 gig, and then the color of the phone which is silver and then it'll ask you to select the condition of the phone. New, refurbished, used, in this case mine is used. And then it'll ask you for the cosmetic condition of the phone. Mine's good, it's a little roughed up so I'm gonna go ahead and select good and then from there, it'll ask you what accessories the phone comes with. In this case I have no accessories. So once you select last and then from there it'll ask you what accessories the phone comes with in this case i have no accessories so once you select last and final option and will present you with two prices one to either sell it yourself or in this case click sell it with quick self if you've chosen to sell your phone through quick cell will need to gather basic information such as your paypal account your shipping address and then you'll just need to click confirm your quick cell in what you've confirmed your quick sell will provide basic instructions on preparing your phone for PayPal account, your shipping address, and then you'll just need to click confirm your QuickSell. Then once you've confirmed your QuickSell, we'll provide basic instructions on preparing your phone for shipment and then we'll direct you to print your prepaid free shipping label and packing slip, and then from there you pack it, ship it, and that's it. A few clicks, ship it, and you get paid. A few notes. While we're eager to expand Quick-sell, we currently only accept smartphones that are in excellent to good condition. Also, in order to accept payment for quick-sell, we do require an active PayPal email account. I hope this information has been helpful, and you're as excited for the quickicksilk program as we are.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an eBay-branded instructional walkthrough for selling a smartphone through Quick Sale. The described process involves selecting device details and condition, receiving shipping instructions and a prepaid label, shipping the phone, and receiving payment. Requests for a PayPal email and shipping details are framed as ordinary payment and shipment logistics, with no separate scam mechanism established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is an ordinary phone-selling service and its transaction logistics: the speaker describes selling a phone through QuickSale, supplying payment and shipping details, and shipping the device before receiving payment. The video does not establish that every service claim is independently verified.
